title: associate accuracy settings
description: The accuracy method's settings (accuracy.json). Structural shape only; cross-field rules (modes cover exactly the registry, the source-kind table covers exactly tool_names, exempt tools are registered, check ids are unique, refusal_checks names only listed checks, the support-score ranges and its switch covering exactly the registry) live in validate.validate_accuracy.

mode.description: Registry model key -> report or enforce.

support_score.description: Settings for the support score: the decider's answer to one choice question, how much of the fact's value a found quote, on its own, shows. Report-only. Optional: a file without it has the score off for every model. Ranges, the option and pass rules, and registry coverage of `enabled` live in validate.validate_accuracy.

question.description: The choice question asked of the decider, sent as written.

background.description: What the decider is told before each pair: what a value and a quote are, and when a value counts as shown. Sent as written, before the value and quote. Optional.

options.description: The question's answers, in order: option key -> the criterion the decider is given for it. At least two (validate.validate_accuracy).

passes.description: The option keys reported as the quote supporting the value. Distinct option keys, never every option (validate.validate_accuracy).

timeout_ms.description: Time allowed for one fact's request.

max_facts.description: Most facts scored for one hand-back; the rest are recorded as not scored.

total_timeout_ms.description: Time allowed for all scoring of one hand-back.

enabled.description: Registry model key -> whether the score is asked for that model's runs.

finish_reminder.description: Settings for the finish reminder (deviation d3): what the extension sends a model whose task run is about to settle without an accepted finish, and how often. Optional: a file without it means no reminder. The range of `max` lives in validate.validate_accuracy.

max.description: How many reminders one session may send (at least 1).

text.description: The reminder sent to the model, as written.

source_kinds.description: Tool name -> source kind of an entry that tool produces.

refusal_checks.description: Reason a checker gives (a refusal or a flag) -> id of the check in checks it belongs to. The checker code owns the reason names; the contract owns which check each one counts under.
